call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 20-25% with EBITDA margin of 35-40%.
Order book at ₹2,654 Cr including negotiated orders; ₹920 Cr as on 30 June 2026.
Expects around ₹2,000 Cr of fresh order inflows in FY27 over and above orders already received and negotiated.
Net debt free with cash, bank balances and investments of ₹530 Cr as on 30 June 2026.
Plans capex of ₹150-200 Cr minimum over the next two years for infrastructure, clean rooms and test facilities.
Addressable market seen at ₹40,000-50,000 Cr, but no timeline for conversion.
Negotiated orders have taken about six months longer than expected; contracts expected in the next few months.
BrahMos seekers commercial order expected before end of this year.
FY26 order inflows were about ₹1,121 Cr, up 216% YoY, diversified across radar, avionics, EW and services.
A further ₹1,900 Cr of single-vendor repeat contracts on delivered products is expected during FY27, timing not controlled by the company.
Management said contract-to-contract margins vary and it takes some strategic contracts at lower margin to build capability.
The company remains debt-free as of March 2026.
BrahMos seeker production orders expected in 4-5 months; the development variant order has been delivered.
Asked for a year-end order book number, management declined, saying it is too early and it will revisit towards Q2-Q3.
About 1,200 engineers in-house; product development is expensed except a few capitalised cases.

A further ₹1,900 Cr of single-vendor repeat contracts on already-delivered products is expected during FY27, with timelines not in the company's control.
Export order book was about ₹53 Cr; the IMD radar development and service order, the largest in Q4, has a requirement of over 18 months.
Order book was ₹920 Cr as on 30 June 2026 and ₹2,654 Cr including July orders and negotiated orders.
International order book stands at ₹39 Cr.

watchlist.response: CMD declined, saying it is too early and the company will come back towards Q2-Q3 or year-end
